Ninety percent of the people in South Korea do not live the kind of life you live. Some celebrities identify themselves as Christians, yet instead of proclaiming God’s truth in the spheres of politics, economics, education, and culture, they appear to simply elevate themselves. In that sense, calling oneself a Christian without standing for God’s truth can feel like using God for one’s own image.
Every day, laws are being introduced that seem to move the nation toward a more centralized and authoritarian system. Yet many hesitate to declare that God is King over all. If we claim to trust God but remain silent in such times, are we not in danger of underestimating Him?
God delivered this nation and brought “Joseon” out of oppression, allowing it to grow into a prosperous country. To say that politics is not our place and therefore remain silent and offer no resistance, while the nation drifts, is a failure of responsibility as citizens of God’s Kingdom. It is, in effect, abandoning our calling as children of God.
